name: morph-select
title: Morph Select
description: A select whose field stretches open into its list; a highlight glides to your pick as it folds back.

perf.budget: A modal of plain views: the panel height and every row read one shared value, and one more moves the highlight. Nothing runs at rest.

measurements.notes: p99 spikes are the first frame of the modal window opening.

a11y.reducedMotion: The list opens and closes at once and the highlight jumps.
a11y.screenReader: A button that reads the label and the current choice and says whether it is expanded; options are menu items with a selected state.
a11y.touchTarget: The field is 52 pt tall and each option 48 pt.
